## About
Etak Travels & Tours Expert Limited is a CAC-registered (RC 898792), IATA-affiliated travel management company based in Abuja, Nigeria. Founded in 2010, we have over 16 years of experience providing professional travel services for individuals, families, businesses, and organisations across Nigeria and beyond.
